title: Change Snooze Intervals
body:
Is it possible to change "snooze intervals"?

I'm talking about these values:
![photo_2020-02-23_03-41-53 c](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31447095/75102109-fccb9800-55ee-11ea-9a33-2e688bc97729.jpg)

If press and hold finger on one of values, it becames a text field:
![photo_2020-02-23_03-41-52 (2)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31447095/75102125-55029a00-55ef-11ea-98d6-0087e2678fd4.jpg)

But when I change value to another:
![photo_2020-02-23_03-41-53 (3)](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/31447095/75102126-559b3080-55ef-11ea-9602-cd0282476ca7.jpg)
Changing doesn't affect on result (20 lefts 20).

And if it's not possible to change snooze intervals directly, maybe there exists some another way to change these values?

I need to remove 20 minutes and change 40 and 50 minutes to 45.
